verdict.rationale: Deepgram ships an official 'dg' CLI that can transcribe, stream, synthesize speech, and manage account operations from the terminal, with a dedicated getting-started doc, and it even embeds an MCP server enabling AI coding tools to call Deepgram APIs directly, reinforcing agentic/AI-native usage. missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports validating the CLI's real-world reliability beyond first-party docs.
